title: Import agent sessions
description: Bring your Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode command-line histories into Cognia as continuable conversations.
cardBody: Import past sessions from Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode.
emptyHint: Nothing was found on disk. Try choosing session files manually.
unrecognized: These files weren't recognized as a supported agent session.
webHint: Auto-scan needs the desktop app. On the web, choose session files manually.
doneBody: Added {sessions, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} with {messages, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}.
liveSyncHint: Keep watching these agents and import new sessions automatically. A session you continue in Cognia is frozen and never overwritten.
